title: Fema / RBI | RBI Circular on UAPA Section 51A: Three UNSC Sanctions Entries Amended
description:
RBI directs regulated entities to comply with amendments to three UNSC ISIL and Al-Qaida sanctions entries under Section 51A of UAPA.
The post RBI Circular on UAPA Section 51A: Three UNSC Sanctions Entries Amended appeared first on TaxGuru.
